title: Loosened capture-exemption assertion no longer pins unparseable/non-object validation.json (with neither session file) as a loud failure
evidence: Mutation on tree-real-data.test.ts inProgressLabel: changing the catch to return a label (unparseable validation.json => in-progress) leaves the suite green (fail 0); removing the non-object guard also survives. Cause: the malformed-capture test now asserts missing.length+inProgress.length==1, which accepts either outcome, and the new fail-loud test only covers dirs that have a session file. Manifest claims unparseable/empty fails; only unparseable session files are pinned.
fix_direction: Add fixtures: neither session file + validation.json of '{', '', '5', '"x"' must land in missing, not inProgress; restore exact missing==1 for those cases.

title: New in-progress rule is in tension with contract index-corpus-stage-discovery C3 (partial processed folders must fail; extra turns/claims cannot excuse a partial folder)
evidence: qa/contracts/index-corpus-stage-discovery.md C3: 'unknown partial processed folders must be reported as failures, not removed from the denominator'. A folder with turns/claims/source + validation.json but no session.json/session_page.json is now skipped instead of failing; a finalized session whose BOTH session files were deleted is indistinguishable from a live ingest and silently drops out (floor of 23 still enforced, and it is logged). The old status:failed capture case and the extra-subdir case were removed/loosened.
fix_direction: Umesh to acknowledge the rule change against C3 so the checker can update the contract; optionally treat in-progress dirs older than N days (mtime) as failures.
